title: AIDD marketplace package manifest
description: One catalog/packages/<id>/package.json per installable package. Validated by skill/scripts/validate_catalog_entry.py before a submission is accepted.

id.description: Must match the containing folder name exactly (catalog/packages/<id>/).

kind.description: provider = tasks_to_issues.py issue tracker; adapter = agent command target; template = a spec/design-system template; hook = a Claude Code enforcement hook. Determines which install-destination convention applies — see catalog/README.md. As of v1, 'marketplace.py install' only actually installs 'adapter' and 'template' kinds (pure file copy, no code wiring needed) — 'provider' and 'hook' validate against this schema so a submission can be reviewed and merged ahead of the dynamic-loading support they need, but installing one prints a clear not-yet-supported message instead of silently doing nothing.

files.description: Maps a destination path (relative to the installing project root) to a source path relative to this package's own files/ folder. Every source path is validated to resolve inside files/ — no '..', no absolute paths.
